chapter: Portraits from Hemphill to Getz, and the bebop question
title: Benny Morton, Dave Dexter's DownBeat, and Morton in Redman's and Lena's bands
summary: Horace first met Benny Morton when Don Redman added trombones at Connie's Inn, and used him in the Lena Horne eight-piece.
